title: Thumbnails and Captions
summary: Thumbnails and captions are the gateway — test hook lines and short thumbnail text.

sections.heading: Orientation
sections.subtitle: Introduction
sections.contentMarkdown:
- **What will you understand?** **After** **creating multiple content forms from a single idea** — **the question now is:** **How do you make each version visible and engaging?**
- **Thumbnail and caption** **are the viewer's first decision:** **click or skip**.
bullets: **What will you understand?** **After** **creating multiple content forms from a single idea** — **the question now is:** **How do you make each version visible and engaging?**
**Thumbnail and caption** **are the viewer's first decision:** **click or skip**.

sections.heading: Tension
sections.subtitle: The Problem
sections.contentMarkdown:
- **A weak entry** **loses excellent content**.
- **If the image is dull** **or the text is long and unclear** — **the viewer won't give the video a chance**.
- **Also, if the first line of the caption is boring** — **the reader won't reach the important point**.
bullets: **If the image is dull** **or the text is long and unclear** — **the viewer won't give the video a chance**.
**Also, if the first line of the caption is boring** — **the reader won't reach the important point**.

sections.heading: Core Idea
sections.subtitle: Make the entry clear and easy to understand
sections.contentMarkdown:
- **A good thumbnail:** **minimal text**, **strong contrast**, **and a clear idea at first glance**.
- **A good caption:** **First line as a hook** — **then a sentence that quickly explains the benefit**.
- **Test 2 or 3 beginnings for the caption** — **and choose the one that conveys the meaning fastest**.
- **Don't mix messages:** **Each thumbnail** **should have one clear promise**.

sections.heading: Comparison
sections.subtitle: Cluttered text or a message that opens the door?
sections.contentMarkdown:
| Weak Style | Stronger Style |
|----------------|----------------|
| **Thumbnail with too much text** **and a caption that starts with a long introduction** — **the viewer gets bored before understanding** | **Focused thumbnail with few words** **and a caption that starts with an engaging sentence** **related to the benefit** |

sections.heading: Glossary
sections.subtitle: 3 Key Terms
sections.contentMarkdown:
| Term | Meaning | Example |
|---------|--------|------|
| **Hook Line** | **The first line** **that grabs attention quickly** | «**Most people make mistakes at this step**» |
| **Thumbnail Text** | **The few words** **that appear on the thumbnail** | **3 clear words** **are better than a long sentence** |
| **CTR (Click-Through Rate)** | **The percentage of people** **who clicked** **after seeing the title and image** | **Improving the entry increases clicks** **even before changing the content** |

sections.heading: Quiz
sections.subtitle: Quick Confirmation
sections.contentMarkdown:
> **Quiz key (unchanged):** correctIndex: 1

**Question:** **Your content is useful** **but the reach is weak** — **which choice improves the entry quickly?**

Make the caption much longer** **to explain all the details**.**
**Write 3 hook beginnings for the caption** **and test the strongest** **with concise thumbnail text**.
Keep the same image and caption** **and change only the music**.**

**Explanation:** **Testing the beginnings of the caption** **with a clear thumbnail** **provides the fastest improvement** **in the click decision**.

Keep the same image and caption** **and change only the music**.**

sections.heading: Mission
sections.subtitle: Write 3 caption openings or thumbnail texts
sections.contentMarkdown:
**Introduction:** **Choose one video** — **write 3 versions for the entry:** **either 3 caption openings** **or 3 thumbnail texts**.

**Submission:** version 1 · 2 · 3 · **the strongest version and why**

**Evaluation Criteria:**

| Dimension | Weight | Criteria |
|-------|-------|---------|
| Variety of formulations | 50% | **The three versions are genuinely different** — **not just one word changed** |
| Thoughtful choice | 50% | **The final version choice** **is based on the clarity of the promise to the audience** |

sections.heading: Confidence Close
sections.contentMarkdown:
- **You understood:** **You are not just decorating the content** — **but making it easier for people** **to access and understand it quickly**.
- **You can:** **Apply the three versions to one video** — **and you will see a clear difference in response**.
- **Next:** **Choosing platforms** — **start from where your audience's attention is**.
